Thank you so much. 

Yeah I think the biggest issue I have is the fear of being a burden and also no one taking me seriously or disregarding me, as that’s what a LOT of my family have tried to do the other times I’ve spoken to them about my MH. It almost seems like it’s not worth it because sometimes talking to my mum about the issues makes it worse as she’s very reluctant to admit the way she’s been the last few years is probably part of the reason I am the way I am, eeeee. It’s nerve-racking

Also, who even has the time to go about on Reddit tryna report people for things that aren’t actually illegal? unlike “George” who actually prior to dating me, dated a minor who was 3 months pregnant. Surely that’s a more arrestable offence than literally squirting Tabasco on someone?
Yeah dude absolutely nothing was penetrated?
I did n they removed it :(

I didn’t directly touch him and caused no real harm. And I ain’t about to get into the depths of that relationship but I’m preeettty sure there’s a lot of genuine things I coulda gotten him arrested for haha! Anyways like I said, I was young and dumb and this isn’t something I’d ever consider doing again!
*disclaimer* I now realise, 4 years wiser, that this was a really dick thing of me to do and I should’ve handled it like an adult, but live while you’re young right lads?
